text:
I estimated each item from the photo, then summed them. I can't see what will be left over, so the leftover figure is an assumption.

Estimated items served:
- 2 fried eggs: about 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat.
- 1 slice of sourdough toast: about 130 kcal, 4 g protein, 25 g carbs, 1 g fat.
- Avocado, about half: about 130 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 7 g carbs, 12 g fat.
- Roasted tomato halves: about 40 kcal, 1 g protein, 5 g carbs, 2 g fat.
- Mushrooms: about 20 kcal, 2 g protein, 2 g carbs, 0.5 g fat.
- Muffin: about 650 kcal is too high for this size, so I used about 350 kcal, 5 g protein, 48 g carbs, 16 g fat.
- Latte: about 120 kcal, 6 g protein, 10 g carbs, 6 g fat.

Total served is about 970 kcal.

I assumed about 10% is left over, roughly 90 kcal, so about 880 kcal is eaten. Scaling the macros to match gives roughly 29 g protein, 90 g carbs and 48 g fat.
